_note: The paper accounts the bot runs. PAPER ONLY: virtual money, public price data, no exchange keys. Change a strategy's params here (or add an account) and the next run picks it up. A brand-new id starts a fresh account; changing params of an existing id keeps its balance and history.

accounts.label: EMA Crossover
accounts.why: Trend following: buys when the 20-hour average crosses above the 100-hour one.

accounts.label: RSI Dip-Buyer
accounts.why: Mean reversion: buys sharp dips (RSI under 35), sells on the bounce.

accounts.label: Donchian Breakout
accounts.why: Breakout: buys a new 100-hour high, exits on a 10-hour low.

accounts.label: Just Hold BTC
accounts.why: Benchmark: buys BTC once with all its money at the start and never sells.
